hooks.command: WHEEL_URL='https://github.com/agentydragon/ducktape/releases/download/claude-hooks-c903d782/claude_hooks-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl'; INSTALLED_URL=$(cat ~/.local/share/uv/tools/claude-hooks/lib/python*/site-packages/claude_hooks-*.dist-info/direct_url.json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c 'import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get("url",""))' 2>/dev/null); [ "$INSTALLED_URL" = "$WHEEL_URL" ] || uv tool install --upgrade "claude_hooks @ $WHEEL_URL"; claude-session-start
